# Decisions

Rulings are David's. Proposals are Claude's and stay marked until David rules. Numbers carry over from the demo's `DECISIONS.md` and `arkhe-candidates.md`. Rulings marked _(to build)_ are ruled but not yet in the code.

React unchanged                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | 2 Nov  |
| P36       | Modal focus return (audit #71): `finalFocus` stays as an override. Without it, a modal remembers the focused opener on open (the last pressed element when focus sits on the body, as after a Safari mouse click) and ranks nearby nodes: its siblings, then its parent's, then its grandparent's (depth 2), up to 10 per level, nearest first, older before newer. On close: `finalFocus`, else the live opener, else the first ranked node still in the page (itself or its first focusable child), else the body. Core `FocusReturn`                                                                                                                                                                                                 | 2 Nov  |
| P38       | Live announcements (audit #33, #66): one announcer per `ArkheProvider`, like labels. It mounts a polite and an assertive region straight in the body, marked `data-live-announcer` so a modal's hiding leaves them audible, before any child speaks. `Status` and `SkeletonGroup` hold no live role; they hand their text to it on mount and on change, errors assertive. Without a provider the regions are made on first use, 100 ms ahead of the message. `announceOnMount` dropped                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | 2 Nov  |
